description: This file defines the 'DroppingMessageMapper' class, an implementation of 'MessageMapper' that always outputs empty lists for message mapping operations, effectively dropping messages. It includes static constants for an alias and a mapping context, and overrides mapping methods to return empty collections.

classes.name: DroppingMessageMapper
classes.description: An implementation of MessageMapper that ignores incoming messages and always returns empty lists, effectively dropping messages.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Overrides configuration method; does nothing, ignoring the provided config.

methods.name: map (ExternalMessage message)
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to an empty list of Adaptable objects, representing message drop.

methods.name: map (Adaptable adaptable)
methods.description: Maps an Adaptable object to an empty list of ExternalMessages, effectively dropping the message.
